claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.verification_rationale: The canonical name is mapped to a MITRE ATT&CK group ID.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Confucius was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-mitre-intrusion-set. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: confuciusapt
claims.statement: Confucius APT is associated with Confucius with scope overlapping.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=knowledge-base; vendor scope must be preserved.

claims.subject: relationship--confucius--mitre--de1069e554576388
claims.statement: Confucius related-to Patchwork: Security researchers have noted similarities between [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) and [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040), particularly in their respective custom malware code and targets.(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Feb 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Aug 2021)(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
